changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE listing_apartment_search (
id BIGINT NOT NULL,
title VARCHAR(255), description TEXT, owner_id BIGINT, property_id BIGINT,
region VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, populated_area VARCHAR(255), street VARCHAR(255), house_number VARCHAR(50), building_number VARCHAR(50), apartment_number VARCHAR(50),
square DECIMAL(10, 2), own VARCHAR(50), first_owner BOOLEAN,
deal_type VARCHAR(50), price DECIMAL(19, 2), promotion_id BIGINT,
apartment_type VARCHAR(50),
rooms_number INT, ceiling_height DECIMAL(4, 2), renovation VARCHAR(50), bathroom VARCHAR(50), material VARCHAR(50), completion_date DATE, year_built INT, floors_number INT, view VARCHAR(255), balcony VARCHAR(50), window_type VARCHAR(50), window_material VARCHAR(50), layout_feature VARCHAR(50), layout_type VARCHAR(50),
kitchen_square DECIMAL(4, 2), floor INT, elevator VARCHAR(50), ramp VARCHAR(50), side VARCHAR(50),
developer_id BIGINT, developer_name VARCHAR(255), complex_id BIGINT, complex_name VARCHAR(255),
is_included_in_search BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
CONSTRAINT pk_listing_apartment_search PRIMARY KEY (id, region) ) PARTITION BY LIST (region);
